result.note: Tests the venue of Exercise Tarang Shakti and the first-time participation of US F-35s, both stated in the story.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about Exercise Tarang Shakti held in September 2026:
items: The exercise was held at Jamnagar.
US F-35 stealth fighters trained with the Indian Air Force for the first time during the exercise.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 is wrong because the exercise was held in Jodhpur, not Jamnagar. Statement 2 is correct: it marked the first time US F-35s trained with the IAF, and six other nations also took part.
questions.source: US F-35 stealth fighters trained with the Indian Air Force for the first time at Exercise Tarang Shakti in Jodhpur, alongside six other nations.
